purpose: Machine-readable intake gate for external source-review acceptance of the C01 beta18 H6 source migration candidate. It validates reviewer refs when supplied while keeping production proof/VK, adapter, mutation/no-mutation, SBF/live-lineage, and audit acceptance blocked.

requiredConclusions: candidate source equals current H6 source with the beta18-compatible Poseidon import
H6 context preimage fields and Poseidon6 assertion are preserved
Prover.toml fixture matches current H6 source fixture
source review did not inspect or require raw witness, proof, VK, PK, keypair, secret, or signed transaction bytes

validates: current source already uses the beta18-compatible Poseidon import
H6 context preimage and Poseidon6 preservation
no raw proof/VK/witness/key/secret/transaction material in env-supplied JSON
externalSourceReviewValidation.truthBoundary: This makes external source-review acceptance intake executable but does not supply acceptance and does not promote production source lineage. Without VANTA_C01_BETA18_H6_SOURCE_REVIEW_ACCEPTANCE_PATH, C01 remains blocked with accepted source-review refs null.

promotionRules: source-review acceptance refs must be references only; raw proof, verifying-key, proving-key, witness, keypair, secret, and signed transaction bytes stay out of git
source-review acceptance can cover only the beta18 H6 source migration delta, not production setup, proof-format, VK, adapter, mutation/no-mutation, SBF/live-lineage, or audit evidence
production artifact acceptance must require a sourceReviewAcceptanceRef before it can promote a beta18 source-migration bundle
reviewed source migration is a prerequisite to production source lineage but does not by itself close C01
remainingBlockers: no reviewed compatible Sunspot/Noir beta18 toolchain provenance
no production setup or toxic-waste mitigation
no deterministic reviewed production artifact build
no reviewed production artifact bundle accepted
no production valid mutation or invalid/wrong-input/wrong-key no-mutation evidence
truthBoundary: This is a blocked external source-review acceptance gate for the C01 beta18 H6 source migration candidate. It defines refs-only validation for reviewer acceptance, but it is not reviewer acceptance, not production source lineage, not production setup, not production proof-format evidence, not production VK/hash evidence, not production verifier-adapter acceptance, not production mutation/no-mutation evidence, not SBF/live lineage, not audit/reviewer acceptance, and not C01 closure.
